errors.description: timestamp_word_q is a multi-bit value produced in ptp_clk and sampled directly in mac_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
stamp_pulse_q is a one-cycle ptp_clk pulse consumed directly in mac_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
stamp_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample mac_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in mac_event_o.
time_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector time_mode_q before decoding in mac_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
ptp_rst_n is used as data inside mac_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
csr_snapshot_q combines ptp_clk payload state with mac_clk status state in csr_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
